newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - April 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - April 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Manila Archbishop Jaime Cardinal Sin on Monday warned President Ramos against running for a second term, adding that he was seeing in the move shades of the late dictator Ferdinand Marcos. (INQUIRER)

- Internal Revenue Commissioner Liwayway Vinzons Chato was sued yesterday for 288 million pesos in damages by Fortune Tobacco Corp, the flagship company of Filipino-Chinese tycoon Lucio Tan. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- President Ramos' appointment of former Armed Forces chief General Arturo Enrile as the new secretary of the Department of Transportation and Communications on Monday drew fire from opposition legislators who accused Ramos of "militarizing" the government. (CHRONICLE/TODAY)
- Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp cut its prices for unleaded gasoline and diesel by 10 centavos per litre. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- The management of San Miguel Corp is expected to face intense grilling on Tuesday at the annual stockholders meeting on its controversial decision to sell its 70 percent-owned Coca-Cola Bottlers to Coca-Cola Amatil of Australia.
- The Philippine Central Bank launches today in New York its inaugural Yankee bond issue worth $1.0 billion. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
